dedupe_keys.name: sum4re lidar point clouds and ifc models of buildings for digital urban mining

description: This dataset holds LiDAR point clouds and target IFC models of indoor and outdoor building environments captured in the SUM4Re project, 'Creating Materials Banks from Digital Urban Mining'. It was published on Zenodo on 21 April 2026 by Jesús Balado Frías, Juan Carlos Navares Vázquez, Clara Garcia Moll, Alejandro Fernández Copóns, Ana Sánchez Rodríguez and Pedro Arias of CINTECX GeoTECH at the Universidade de Vigo. Scans from terrestrial and mobile scanners (file names cite RS10, RTC360 and HoloLens 2) capture architectural elements and construction components to support identifying, characterising and documenting materials in existing buildings. Coverage: sites named Anoeta and Jolastokieta in San Sebastián (Spain), a site in Longyearbyen (Norway), and Target and Donor buildings in The Hague (Netherlands). Access: twelve LAZ files on Zenodo, the largest about 1.3 GB. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the file list read shows point clouds only, although the description also mentions IFC models. Simulation uses: scan-to-BIM, material banks for reuse of building components, and condition documentation of existing buildings. Related records: the URBAN PERiSCOPE pilot building and the Material stock maps.
